Assign accessions to haplotypes

Source: R/haplotypes.R
getHapCombSamples.Rd

Accessions whose alleles match a haplotype exactly are assigned to it. Accessions with some missing calls (up to `hap_max_missing`) are assigned to the single haplotype compatible with their observed alleles. All other accessions are pooled as `"Other"`.

Usage

getHapCombSamples(haplotypes, hapmap, savecopy = TRUE)

Arguments

haplotypes

A haplotype table (from [convertLDclusters2Haps()])

hapmap

A list of HapMap data frames (from [readHapmap()])

savecopy

Save a copy (`tables/haplotype_accessions.csv`) in the output folder

Value

The haplotype table with an extra `"Other"` row per block and the columns `n` (number of accessions), `freq` and `samples` (`|`-separated).
